scope: Pass B full-surface expansion for the official Twilio public REST API v2010 OpenAPI file (twilio_api_v2010.json) plus the legacy Twilio streams. All documented v2010 GET endpoints are covered as streams; all documented v2010 POST and DELETE endpoints are covered as typed write actions. Separate Twilio product APIs with distinct hosts/versions are outside this connector bundle because metadata and legacy code scope this connector to api.twilio.com/2010-04-01.
